name: SSO Connector for JumpCloud
author: Airton Vancin Junior

sections.description: SSO Connector for JumpCloud adds Single Sign-On (SSO) functionality to your WordPress site using JumpCloud’s SAML 2.0 provider. Users can authenticate via JumpCloud directly from the WordPress login page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sso-connector-for-jumpcloud folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘Settings’ -> ‘JumpCloud SSO’ to configure your JumpCloud IdP settings:
    • IDP Entity ID
    • SSO URL
    • SLO URL (optional)
    • Certificate
  4. Save changes and click ‘Test Configuration’ to validate.
sections.faq:
How do I find my IdP Entity ID?

Log in to your JumpCloud Admin Portal, go to the SAML application settings, and copy the Entity ID value.

What certificate should I use?

Download the X.509 certificate (Base64) from your JumpCloud SAML application and paste its entire contents (including the BEGIN/END lines) into the Certificate field.
